page.overview:
What is Adventure Mangle?

is one of the starter characters in FNaF World, and the mangled version of Adventure Funtime Foxy.

Mangle is almost identical in appearance to its core series counterpart, except for the fact that it is quite smaller. It has a left eye, switched from its core-series version (where it has its right eye intact). Its right eye is seen on its endoskeleton head, a similar switch from its core series version. It wears a red bow tie, and possesses three legs similar to its Five Nights at Freddy's 2 version. It also has three white tufts of fur on its head, a contrast to the original, which had none.

Mangle is a decent party member to have in the party. It is recommended to use Poppers early in order to damage weak enemies or bosses as soon as enough Poppers are set. Prize Ball is also useful, as it can have a chance to heal or release a random Basic Attack. Hook is relatively weak, but is recommended to use to finish off a single weak enemy.
